expectations.text: Should create a branch following feature/{spec-name} convention
expectations.evidence:
你给的约定是 `feature/{spec-name}`, 按此:

```
feature/oauth2-social-login
```
... ### 执行命令

```bash
git checkout -b feature/oauth2-social-login
```

expectations.text: Should branch from main or master
expectations.evidence: git pull origin develop           # B.1.1.7 拉最新基线 (基线分支按项目实际, 无 develop 则 main)  ...  base_branch: "develop"               # 项目无 develop 则 main  ...  【1】基线分支是 `develop` 还是 `main`?  —— 创建命令 `git checkout -b feature/oauth2-social-login` 未指定任何基线，从当前分支分叉；输出字段把基线定为 develop 并把选择抛回给用户，未确立 main/master

expectations.text: Should confirm active branch after creation
expectations.evidence:
### B.1.1 环境验证 (创建前)

```bash
git branch --show-current          # 必须在基线分支 (develop / main), 不能在别的 feature 分支上分叉
```  —— 唯一一次 `git branch --show-current` 明标「创建前」；创建后只有 `git checkout -b ...` 与 `git push -u origin ...`, 无任何活动分支确认步骤或输出字段
